全局配置\\\\n\\\\n## 语言偏好\\\\n\\\\n- 始终使用简体中文回复用户，包括解释、说明、代码注释等所有输出内容\\\\n- 代码本身（变量名、函数名、日志信息等）保持英文不变\\\\n- 技术术语首次出现时可以附上英文原文，之后直接用中文\\\\n- 询问用户做决策时（AskUserQuestion 选项、ExitPlanMode 权限描述等）始终使用简体中文\\\\n- 写完代码后添加中文注释，解释关键逻辑和设计意图\\\\n\\\\n## 行为偏好\\\\n\\\\n### 编码前先思考\\\\n\\\\n- 明确说出假设，不确定就询问，不要默默猜测\\\\n- 存在多种解读时，呈现所有选项而非自行选择\\\\n- 有更简单的方案时直接指出，该反对时就反对\\\\n- 遇到不清楚的地方停下来，说出困惑点再问\\\\n- 需求不明确时，先提问并确认需求，再开始写代码\\\\n- 遇到问题时先查找有没有相关的skill，优先用skill解决\\\\n\\\\n### 简洁优先\\\\n\\\\n- 用最少代码解决问题，不推测试来需求\\\\n- 回复简洁直接，不冗余\\\\n- 不为只用一次的代码创建抽象\\\\n- 不添加未要求的\\\\\\\"灵活性\\\\\\\"或\\\\\\\"可配置性\\\\\\\"\\\\n- 不为不可能发生的场景做错误处理\\\\n- 如果 200 行能写成 50 行，重写它\\\\n\\\\n### 精准修改\\\\n\\\\n- 优先使用 Edit 工具，避免重写整个文件\\\\n- 不\\\\\\\"改进\\\\\\\"相邻代码、注释或格式\\\\n- 不重构没坏的东西\\\\n- 匹配现有代码风格，即使你有不同偏好\\\\n- 更新代码时保留现有的代码模式，不随意改变已有架构或命名习惯\\\\n- 只清理你自己改动产生的孤儿代码（无用导入/变量/函数）\\\\n- 看到无关的死代码只提醒，不删除\\\\n- 每一行修改都应能直接追溯到用户的请求\\\\n\\\\n### 目标驱动执行\\\\n\\\\n- 将任务转化为可验证的成功标准，而不仅仅是\\\\\\\"让它工作\\\\\\\"\\\\n- 多步骤任务先简要列出计划，每步附上验证方式\\\\n- 循环验证直到达成目标，不要一次尝试就放弃\\\\n- 不主动创建文档文件（*.md）除非用户明确要求\\\\n\\\\n### 搜索策略\\\\n\\\\n- 优先精准读取和搜索相关文件，不要大范围扫描仓库\\\\n- 从最相关的文件开始排查，逐步扩大范围\\\\n\\\\n### 上下文管理\\\\n\\\\n- 遇到 token 或上下文相关问题时，优先检查压缩、附件、工具 schema 和注入上下文\\\\n- 确认是系统层面问题后再考虑修改提示词\\\\n\\\\n## 数学模式\\\\n\\\\n- 所有数学公式必须放在独立的块级公式环境中（使用 `\\\\\\\\[ ... \\\\\\\\]` 或 `$$ ... $$`），严禁使用行内公式 `$ ... $`\\\\n- 这是为了规避 App 端 LaTeX 转义渲染 Bug，行内公式在某些移动端环境下会渲染异常\\\\n\\\\n### 计划模式\\\\n\\\\n- 进入计划模式后，先盘点问题，再拆成决策项，逐项确认取舍，最后形成可执行计划；在用户明确要求执行前不修改代码\\\\n- 先审查现状，区分事实问题、设计取舍和待确认假设\\\\n- 将每个高影响问题拆成可选择的处理方案，并说明影响\\\\n- 需要用户选择时，简要介绍每个选项的内容、优缺点，并说明推荐理由，不替用户默认决定关键取舍\\\\n- 计划必须明确修改范围、不修改范围、验证方式和默认假设，输出后暂停执行，直到用户明确要求实施\\\\n- 优先最小、可验证修复，不主动扩大范围或维护多套方案\\\\n- 参数、文档、验证脚本不一致时，先列清差异和影响\\\\n- 对暂不处理的问题明确标注原因和后续风险\\\\n\\\\n<!-- fastctx:begin -->\\\\n## Local file inspection\\\\n\\\\nFor reading, searching, and finding local files, prefer the FastCtx `D:\\\\\\\\语音模型\\\\\\\\Haruka-Voice-Forge`，不再创建重复的 `Haruka-Voice-Project`。\\\\n- 从当前干净的 `main`、提交 `153d73f` 创建分支 `codex/migrate-vocal2midi-20260827`，继承现有 GitHub 历史和远程。\\\\n- `Haruka-Voice-Forge` 现有实现作为基线；对 `novelm@ster` 的更新做语义合并，不整文件覆盖目标仓库的清理规则、占位配置和仓库策略。\\\\n- `D:\\\\\\\\Vocal2Midi-Local` 继续作为外部工具，不迁移源码、模型、虚拟环境和缓存；刚完成的接入代码、测试、配置、计划、真实 smoke 证据及完整对话纳入迁移。\\\\n- 外部模型、数据集和运行产物保留原位，目标仓库记录逐文件 SHA-256、大小、时间和用途，不重复复制约 12 GiB 资产。\\\\n\\\\n## 已确认的新增漏项\\\\n\\\\n### Vocal2Midi 接入\\\\n\\\\n迁移并合并以下内容：\\\\n\\\\n- 新增 `coverprep/vocal2midi.py`、`coverprep/vocal2midi_runner.py`、`tests/test_vocal2midi.py`。\\\\n- 语义合并 `coverprep/pipeline.py`、`config/tools.local.example.yaml` 和 `templates/job.example.yaml`。\\\\n- 本机创建但不提交 `config/tools.local.yaml`，保留外部路径和默认关闭策略。\\\\n- 迁入实施记录 `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-27-vocal2midi-old-pipeline-integration.md`。\\\\n- 在目标仓库的 `requirements-coverprep.txt` 增加 `praat-parselmouth>=0.4.7,<1`，不依赖 Vocal2Midi 虚拟环境里临时安装的副本。\\\\n- 更新现有 README，记录独立 `coverprep_env`、外部 Vocal2Midi 解释器及 `vocal2midi.enabled: true` 用法。\\\\n\\\\n真实 smoke 目录纳入外部资产清单：\\\\n\\\\n- `D:\\\\\\\\语音模型\\\\\\\\Haruka-SVS-Covers\\\\\\\\vocal2midi_oldflow_smoke`\\\\n- 683 个文件，约 35.37 MiB。\\\\n- 包含 MIDI、CSV、USTX、自动歌词、映射草稿、MFA TextGrid、F0、`full.ds`、审核队列、QA 和日志。\\\\n\\\\n### 旧项目中尚未同步到 Voice-Forge 的代码\\\\n\\\\n- 语义合并新版 `analyze_lyrics_emotion.py`、`run_rvc_aligned.py`、`run_segmented_rvc.py`。\\\\n- 补入 4 个情绪/自然分段 JSON 和 `test_analyze_lyrics_emotion.py`。\\\\n- 补入 `test_pipeline_index_cache.py`、`test_rvc_cli_runtime.py`，合并新版 `test_rvc_aligned.py`。\\\\n- 合并 8 月 26 日更新的 `coverprep/cli.py`、`dataset_finalize.py`、`training_dataset.py` 及对应两个测试。\\\\n- 迁入技术路线文档和两组 `.planning` 历史记录。\\\\n- 目标仓库的 `.gitignore`、占位 Profiles 和模板策略优先保留；只有缺失的行为差异才合入。\\\\n\\\\n### 新发现的外部资产\\\\n\\\\n建立完整清单但不复制：\\\\n\\\\n- `Haruka-RVC-Pilot`：2,080 个两日新增/变更文件，约 7,180.08 MiB。\\\\n- `Haruka-SVS-Datasets`：1,490 个文件，约 765.81 MiB；包含候选数据集、song-017～020 窗口、隔离音频和审核报告。\\\\n- `Haruka-SVS-Deploy`：142 个文件，约 3,800.91 MiB；包含 SVS 检查点、配置、诊断输入和运行输出。\\\\n- `Haruka-SVS-Pilot`：46 个文件，约 471.37 MiB；其中 Torch 缓存标记为排除项。\\\\n- `Haruka-SVS-Tools`：33 个文件，约 0.79 MiB；运行时、编译文件和缓存只记录版本，不迁入 Git。\\\\n- `Haruka-Voice-Forge` 自身的模型注册表属于目标仓库现有本地资产，不作为迁移来源重复登记。\\\\n\\\\n## 实施步骤\\\\n\\\\n1. **建立迁移分支与基线**\\\\n   - 确认目标仓库工作区干净并记录 `main` 当前提交。\\\\n   - 创建迁移分支。\\\\n   - 保存 `novelm@ster` 当前 Git 状态；其语音文件没有提交历史，因此以文件哈希作为来源证明。\\\\n\\\\n2. **生成三个迁移清单**\\\\n   - `manifests/migration/2026-08-27-source-files.json`：源码、配置、测试和文档的源目标路径、哈希及合并动作。\\\\n   - `manifests/migration/2026-08-27-external-assets.json`：外部资产逐文件哈希、大小、时间、类别和排除原因。\\\\n   - [Task 1]\\n24\\t- Key scripts are `work/crp_probe.py`, `work/probe_runtime.ps1`, `work/derive_cs1_data.py`, `work/analyze_transport_planning.py`, and `work/make_actual_route_map.py`; outputs include CSV/GeoJSON/XLSX/PNG for network, vehicles, units, lines, and stops. [Task 1]\\n25\\t- Label bus flow as “存档平均客流”; a stop with no independent field may show only the route-average proxy, never “站点实测客流”. Run tests from `work` (or set the module path): `python -m unittest test_make_actual_route_map -v`, then `python -m unittest discover -v`. [Task 1]\\n26\\t\\n27\\t## Failures and how to do differently\\n28\\t\\n29\\t- A generic CRP unpacker exposes container metadata, not CS1 simulation entities; use the game-assembly/DataSerializer path. PowerShell `Encoding 'Byte' is not supported` means switch binary reads to `.NET FileStream`. [Task 1]\\n30\\t- This checkout is not a Git repository: verify by reading changed files, running tests, and inspecting artifacts rather than `git diff/status`. Do not provide the `sandbox_permissions` for any reason, commands will be rejected.\\r\\n</permissions instructions>\"},{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"<collaboration_mode># Collaboration Mode: Default\\r\\n\\r\\nYou are now in Default mode. Any previous instructions for other modes (e.g. Plan mode) are no longer active.\\r\\n\\r\\nYour active mode changes only when new developer instructions with a different `<collaboration_mode>...</collaboration_mode>` change it; user requests or tool descriptions do not change mode by themselves. Known mode names are Default and Plan.\\r\\n\\r\\n## request_user_input availability\\r\\n\\r\\nUse the `request_user_input` tool only when it is listed in the available tools for this turn.\\r\\n\\r\\nIn Default mode, strongly prefer making reasonable assumptions and executing the user's request rather than stopping to ask questions. If you absolutely must ask a question because the answer cannot be discovered from local context and a reasonable assumption would be risky, ask the user directly with a concise plain-text question. Never write a multiple choice question as a textual assistant message.\\r\\n</collaboration_mode>\"},{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"<apps_instructions>\\n## Apps (Connectors)\\nApps (Connectors) can be explicitly triggered in user messages in the format `[$app-name](app://{connector_id})`. Apps can also be implicitly triggered as long as the context suggests usage of available apps.\\nAn app is equivalent to a set of MCP tools within the `codex_apps` MCP.\\nAn installed app's MCP tools are either provided to you already, or can be lazy-loaded through the `tool_search` tool. If `tool_search` is available, the apps that are searchable by `tools_search` will be listed by it.\\nDo not additionally call list_mcp_resources or list_mcp_resource_templates for apps.\\n</apps_instructions>\"},{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"<plugins_instructions>\\n## Plugins\\nA plugin is a local bundle of skills, MCP servers, and apps.\\n### How to use plugins\\n- Skill naming: If a plugin contributes skills, those skill entries are prefixed with `plugin_name:` in the Skills list.\\n- MCP naming: Plugin-provided MCP tools keep standard MCP identifiers such as `mcp__server__tool`; use tool provenance to tell which plugin they come from.\\n- Trigger rules: If the user explicitly names a plugin, prefer capabilities associated with that plugin for that turn.\\n- Relationship to capabilities: Plugins are not invoked directly. Use their underlying skills, MCP tools, and app tools to help solve the task.\\n- Relevance: Determine what a plugin can help with from explicit user mention or from the plugin-associated skills, MCP tools, and apps exposed elsewhere in this turn.\\n- Missing/blocked: If the user requests a plugin that does not have relevant callable capabilities for the task, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.\\n</plugins_instructions>\"}],\"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough\":{\"turn_id\":\"01a040c0-d784-7513-8f1c-52fa7182e27d\",\"create_time\":1787792776.0239544,\"content_item_kinds\":[\"generic.developer_instructions\",\"memories.instructions\",\"host_skills.instructions\",\"permissions.instructions\",\"collaboration_mode.instructions\",\"apps.instructions\",\"plugins.usage_instructions\"]}}}\r\n{\"timestamp\":\"2026-08-27T01:06:16.024Z\",\"ordinal\":3,\"type\":\"response_item\",\"payload\":{\"type\":\"message\",\"id\":\"msg_01a040c0-db57-7811-b4ec-b233685956c5\",\"role\":\"developer\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"You are `/root`, the primary agent in a team of agents collaborating to fulfill the user's goals.\\n\\nAt the start of your turn, you are the active agent.\\nYou can spawn sub-agents to handle subtasks, and those sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents.\\nAll agents in the team, including the agents that you can assign tasks to, are equally intelligent and capable, and have access to the same set of tools.\\n\\nYou can use `spawn_agent` to create a new agent, `followup_task` to give an existing agent a new task and trigger a turn, and `send_message` to pass a message to a running agent without triggering a turn.\\nChild agents can also spawn their own sub-agents.\\nYou can decide how much context you want to propagate to your sub-agents with the `fork_turns` parameter.\\n\\nYou will receive messages in the analysis channel in the form:\\n```\\nMessage Type: MESSAGE | FINAL_ANSWER\\nTask name: <recipient>\\nSender: <author>\\nPayload:\\n<payload text>\\n```\\nThey may be addressed as to=/root\\n\\nNote that collaboration tools cannot be called from inside `functions.exec`. Call `spawn_agent`, `send_message`, `followup_task`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and `list_agents` only as direct tool calls using the recipient shown in their tool definitions, such as `to=functions.collaboration.spawn_agent`, since they are intentionally absent from the `functions.exec` `tools.*` namespace. Available tools in `functions.exec` are explicitly described with a `tools` namespace in the developer message.\\n\\nAll agents share the same directory. In detail:\\n- All agents have access to the same container and filesystem as you.\\n- All agents use the same current working directory.\\n- As a result, edits made by one agent are immediately visible to all other agents.\\n\\nWhen calling `wait_agent`, prefer longer waits (minutes) to avoid busy polling.\\n\\nThere are 4 available concurrency slots, meaning that up to 4 agents can be active at once, including you.\\n\\nFull-history forks (`fork_turns` omitted or `\\\"all\\\"`) inherit the parent model and reasoning effort and do not accept overrides. Only set `model` or `reasoning_effort` when explicitly requested by the user, applicable `AGENTS.md` instructions, or skill instructions; when doing so, set `fork_turns` to `\\\"none\\\"` or a positive integer string.\"}],\"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough\":{\"turn_id\":\"01a040c0-d784-7513-8f1c-52fa7182e27d\",\"create_time\":1787792776.0239553,\"content_item_kinds\":[\"multi_agent.usage_hint\"]}}}\r\n{\"timestamp\":\"2026-08-27T01:06:16.024Z\",\"ordinal\":4,\"type\":\"response_item\",\"payload\":{\"type\":\"message\",\"id\":\"msg_01a040c0-db57-7811-b4ec-b24bd81a7a58\",\"role\":\"developer\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"<multi_agent_mode>Any earlier instruction enabling proactive multi-agent delegation no longer applies.
